_comment: GET /api/v1/market/products consumed by /gpus GpusSpecsSection (client XHR, 'use client'). Derived from prod capture (gpus-captured.json); no PII in this endpoint (public GPU SKU names + raw 'points' pricing). GpusSpecsSection slices first 4 products and renders a row each: name, `${gpuMemory} GB VRAM`, dealGPUMoney(instancePrice.discount).toFixed(2)+'/hr/GPU', and spot price only when instanceSpotPrice.discount>0 else '—'. 4 products kept (covers: spot present #1/#3, spot null #2/#4) so all branches render deterministically. Pricing fields are raw points (component divides by 100000); kept only the fields the component reads to stay minimal.
